cohort: 128 mothers who gave birth to premature babies at Rafidia governmental surgical hospital
finding: Although mothers who gave birth to newborns with RDS had lower odds of receiving antenatal corticosteroids, this association was not significant after adjusting for gestational age, birth weight, and other factors, suggesting that lower gestational age and IUGR are significant risk factors for RDS.
mod_finding: No significant association was found between mode of delivery and RDS.
